summary: Hiker fell over 50 ft onto a ledge roughly 200 ft up Greyrock around 5:30 PM; LCSAR members climbed to her in the dark, treated injuries, and lowered her down a technical section; she then hiked out. Team home by 4 AM.
responding_agency: Larimer County Search and Rescue; Larimer County Emergency Services; Larimer County Sheriff's Office; UCHealth EMS; Poudre Canyon Fire Protection District
notes: Date approximate: 'the other night' in an Apr-22 post (Apr 20 vs 21 ambiguous).
